thread:
Alex K: Urgent — my flight got cancelled and I'm out. I was primary for the EU overnight slot (22:00-06:00 UTC) which includes tomorrows French bank holiday. Can't do the shift. Can someone step in or at least shadow first 3 hours? I can do a 10m handoff call at 21:45 UTC.
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: service=ingest-pipeline, severity=page, incident_id=INC-2026-701. First alert at 2936123580. Link: https://redwood-incident/INC-2026-701
Nina S: ack. I'm on call tonight as secondary but I have a customer meeting at 00:30 UTC. I can take primary from 22:00-00:30 if that helps.
Jon T: I can cover 00:30-06:00 if Nina takes the first block. Also happy to take the pager for the handoff window.
Alex K: thanks. Nina -> Jon chain works. If nobody volunteers for full 22:00-06:00, Nina covering 22:00-00:30 and Jon 00:30-06:00 is fine. Key notes: INC-2026-701 is affecting a small subset of EU batch uploads (multipart fails ~5%). Customers seeing retries and delayed processing.
Ops-Bot: Current status: INC-2026-701 -> Investigating. Assignees: Alex K (primary), Nina S (secondary). Pager count: 4.
Nina S: quick Q 1  who owns the s3-proxy creds for triggering the emergency requeue? I don't want to call it without consent.
Jon T: I have the key for the requeue endpoint but need Ops approval to run it during holiday windows. Paging runtime-team.
Incident-Bot: Update: mitigation started at 2936123700 (partial retry job kicked off). Successful retry rate: 12/20 batches so far.
Alex K: runbook TL;DR (paste below)  share with Nina and Jon before 21:45 handoff: 
```
Runbook: ingest-pipeline-multipart-failures
1) Check metric: /dash/ingest/errors?incident=INC-2026-701
2) If multipart failures >3% over 5m: scale s3-proxy to +2 replicas: kubectl -n infra scale deploy/s3-proxy --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy/s3-proxy -n infra -o jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+2))
3) If scale doesn't reduce failures in 10m: trigger emergency requeue: POST https://ops.redwood/requeue -d '{"incident":"INC-2026-701","type":"partial"}' (requires ops-approve tag)
4) Notify support channel and update status page using template: [INC-2026-701] brief + ETA
```
Nina S: got it. Can you DM the live console links? Also where's the fallback storage region doc? I want to be ready if we need to reroute writes.
Alex K: DM sent. Fallback doc: https://confluence.redwood/fallbacks/s3-region-failover. Note: during bank holidays the storage team response time may be slower; prefer requeue->drain path before region failover.
Jon T: noted. I'll be up for the shift. Nina, let's do the 21:45 UTC sync for 10m and exchange terminal tabs (tmux) so you can drop in if your meeting runs over.
Nina S: thanks. Also leaving a short checklist in case someone else picks this up last minute: 
- Confirm primary/secondary in rotation calendar
- Read runbook link + open /dash/ingest/errors
- Confirm s3-proxy pod count and current cpu/mem alerts
- Make decision: scale -> monitor 10m -> requeue (ops-approve) -> fallback region
Jon T: I'll add my phone as secondary contact for midnight. If anything escalates to P1 (data loss risk), call me immediately and I'll bridge.
Incident-Bot: Note: INC-2026-701 status changed to "Mitigating" at 2936123880. Current assignee: Alex K (primary).
Alex K: Leaving these final notes in the thread. If you run the emergency requeue, include this tag in the body: "ops-approve: redwood-duty" so runtime team can correlate. And please update the incident timeline in the dashboard after any action.
Nina S: will do. Marking calendar change now and pinging the customer slack aliases if retries keep failing. :white_check_mark:
Jon T: see you both on the 21:45 sync. Thanks Alex, and hope the travel sorts out. :heart:
Alex K: appreciate it; thanks all. DMing everyone my terminal session and the cluster links now.
